query:
INSERT INTO transfers (
                transaction_hash,
                transaction_lt,
                transaction_time,
                sender_wc,
                sender_account,
                recipient_wc,
                recipient_account,
                value,
                status
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, 'New'::transaction_status)
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
            RETURNING transaction_hash
